architecture_blind_spot.finding: The repository's own architecture gate cannot see the real dependency picture.
architecture_blind_spot.mechanism: scripts/architecture.cjs collectImports scans only the files named in each manifest's `modules:`. 9 manifests declare `modules: []` (including tenx and learning); the other 18 declare only their electron/bootstrap factory. 25 files of 594 are scanned, and the keep-condition drops any edge whose target is not a declared module.
architecture_blind_spot.consequence: pnpm run architecture:ratchet reports violations: [] while 43 kernel->feature implementation edges exist. Example invisible to the gate: electron/bootstrap/persistence.ts:24 (a DECLARED kernel module) imports tenx's ../runtime-intelligence/live-capture.
architecture_blind_spot.verification: Counted 9 manifests matching `modules: []` in config/capabilities/*.yaml and read collectImports at scripts/architecture.cjs ~269-295 first-hand.
architecture_blind_spot.impact: ARCHITECTURE_RATCHET=PASS must be read as 'the declared boot-contract graph has no violations', NOT as 'dependencies are clean'. Fixing the measurement is the first act of the city phase.
